title: PBA: Rondae Hollis-Jefferson returns as TNT rolls past Macau

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–TNT nearly reset the six-day record for the most lopsided game in history in the 142-87 demolition of hapless Macau that marked Rondae Hollis-Jefferson’s long-awaited return in the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup on Tuesday at Ninoy Aquino Stadium. Hollis-Jefferson finished with 22 points, six rebounds, five assists and two steals in 22 minutes in his first game back since suffering a torn Achilles when he played for the Meralco Bolts in the East Asia Super League.
